seo.description: SeaDream II, SeaDream Yacht Club's 112-guest yacht: 109 published voyages across The Caribbean, Transatlantic and The Mediterranean, each with its day by day and fares, from US$3,500 per person. Staterooms, suites and deck plans.

tagline: A hundred and twelve guests, ninety-five crew, and a marina that opens off the stern.
answer: SeaDream II is one of SeaDream Yacht Club's twin yachts: 104.8 metres long, with 56 staterooms and suites for 112 guests and a crew of 95. Every stateroom faces the sea. Meals, an open bar, wines with lunch and dinner, gratuities and the marina's water toys are in the fare. SeaDream publishes 109 voyages for her, across The Caribbean, Transatlantic and The Mediterranean, with fares from US$3,500 per person, double occupancy. Each voyage has its own page here with its day by day and the fare of every stateroom and suite.

overview: SeaDream II and SeaDream I are twins, and small by design: 112 guests is a dinner party next to the ships that share their harbours. She calls at small yachting harbours and anchors off beaches, and her marina opens at the stern for kayaks, paddleboards and sailing dinghies.

Life aboard is mostly outdoors. Lunch and dinner are served to order at the Topside Restaurant when the weather allows, the pool is on Deck 3, and Deck 6 has the Balinese Dream Beds, which can be made up for a night under the stars, and the Top of the Yacht Bar.

Inside are the Dining Salon, the Main Salon, a library, the piano bar, a small casino, a fitness centre and the spa, which SeaDream describes as the only Thai-certified spa at sea. Yoga and Tai Chi on deck each morning are in the fare.
SeaDream also charters each yacht whole, for up to 56 couples, in the Caribbean or the Mediterranean.
why: Small enough to anchor where the large ships cannot, with a marina at the waterline.
Close to one crew member for every guest: 95 crew for 112 guests.
The fare covers the things that usually become a bill: the bar, wine with meals, gratuities and the water toys.
Every stateroom and suite faces the sea, and the top deck beds can be made up for a night outside.
SeaDream publishes each voyage with its ports, times and the fare of every category, so the choice is made on facts.
Voyages run back to back, so two can be joined without changing yacht.

faqs: How many guests does SeaDream II carry?
112 guests in 56 staterooms and suites, with a crew of 95.
What is included in the fare aboard SeaDream II?

All meals, an open bar with select premium brands, wines with lunch and dinner, gratuities, the marina's water toys, mountain bikes, the golf simulator, morning yoga and Tai Chi, and room service around the clock. Port and government fees, Wi-Fi, spa treatments, premium wines and spirits, land adventures and laundry are extra.
Where does SeaDream II sail?
SeaDream publishes 109 voyages for her across The Caribbean, Transatlantic and The Mediterranean, from 2026-12-12 to 2029-05-12. Each has its own page with its day by day.
Does SeaDream II sail the Bahamas?

Yes. SeaDream publishes 8 voyages for her that call in the Bahamas, at Sailing the Bahamas Archipelago, Gordon's Beach, Staniel Cay, Taino Beach, Andros Island, Emerald Bay, San Salvador. Each has its own page here.
What staterooms and suites does SeaDream II have?

Yacht Club Staterooms of 195 square feet on Decks 2, 3 and 4; Commodore Suites of 390 square feet, which are two staterooms joined; the 375 square foot Admiral Suite on Deck 4; and the 447 square foot Owner's Suite on Deck 3. All face the sea.
Can children sail aboard SeaDream II?
From one year old. Guests under 18 travel with an adult, and there is no children's programme on board.
How much does a voyage aboard SeaDream II cost?
Published fares start from US$3,500 per person, double occupancy, and vary by voyage and by stateroom or suite. Every voyage page shows the fare of every category as SeaDream publishes it.
What are SeaDream's payment and cancellation terms?

A 25% deposit confirms, and the balance is due 90 days before departure. Cancelling more than 120 days out costs US$200 per booking; from 120 to 91 days, 25% of the fare; 90 to 61 days, 50%; 60 to 31 days, 75%; and 30 days or fewer, the full fare.
Can SeaDream II be chartered whole?
Yes. SeaDream charters each of the twin yachts for up to 56 couples in the Caribbean or the Mediterranean, on a published itinerary or one set with you. Ask James.
Is there Wi-Fi?
Yes, at US$35 a day or US$99 a week.

suits.line: A stateroom on the sea, dinner outdoors, and a bed on deck for one night.
Small enough that the yacht feels shared, and she can be chartered whole.
The marina opens at anchor: kayaks, paddleboards, dinghies and a swim off the stern.
Single fares are on request for every voyage.
Short Caribbean and Bahamas voyages, port to port, with few days at sea.
